evidence_candidates.source_locator: press-release key highlights and feature list
evidence_candidates.excerpt: The CXL Consortium announced CXL 4.0 with a 128 GT/s data rate, bundled-port support, memory RAS enhancements, and backward compatibility with earlier CXL generations.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: In November 2025, the CXL Consortium reported that CXL 4.0 doubles the link data rate to 128 GT/s and adds bundled ports and memory RAS enhancements.
